coldteadotai-pr-lens-eli5.description: WHAT: Explains a codebase, a folder, a feature, a command or a pull request to someone who knows nothing about it, as a PR Lens canvas whose walkthrough builds the picture one part at a time. WHEN: /eli5 <thing>, or asked to explain code simply, for a beginner, a new hire, a non-engineer, or 'like I'm five'. KEYWORDS: eli5, explain like I'm five, explain simply, beginner, onboarding, walkthrough, diagram, PR Lens

coldteadotai-pr-lens-pr-lens.description: WHAT: Draws a code change or part of a codebase as an animated architecture, data-flow or data-model diagram, on its own or in a pull request. WHEN: asked to diagram, visualise or explain a change, a system or a schema change, or when a pull request should carry a diagram. KEYWORDS: PR Lens, diagram, architecture, data flow, data model, schema, ERD, visualise, visualize, pull request
